verdict.rationale: SigNoz's docs say it brings traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform, with collection documented for each signal. They also document pivoting: correlating logs with traces and metrics, and drilling down from any dashboard panel into the underlying logs and traces. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the shared-context mechanism (e.g. trace-ID linking from a trace view to its logs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-signal pivoting.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
Correlate logs with traces and metrics for faster root-cause analysis.
Drill down from any panel: jump into the underlying logs and traces, break out by an attribute
Collect metrics from applications, infrastructure, and existing Prometheus setups. SigNoz also derives APM metrics from traces automatically.
Collect logs from files, stdout, FluentBit/FluentD/Logstash, OpenTelemetry SDKs, HTTP endpoints, and cloud services.
